{{Quote|It was long ago, during the foolish arrogance we called our Expansion Period, ''[&hellip;]'' Even with the primitive ceremonial weapons they still use, we suffered greatly before we came to our senses and made peace with them.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Expansion Period''' was a conflict fought between the [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] species long before<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="Crisis of FaithD" /> Although the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s used primitive [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], the Stromma suffered considerably before surrendering.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Crisis of FaithD" /> [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] requested to see the ancient and fragmentary recordings of the Expansion Period after [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]] mentioned the conflict, believing that as the Quesoth were an insectoid species, knowing their ancient military tactics could be useful in the Empire of the Hand's [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on the Quesoth [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Quesoth]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Expansion Period was mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
